purpose: Standard category-only result ledger for each Goofish/Xianyu page after a browser/profile observation run.

resultStatusEnums.pending-read-only-observation: Live page can be observed only after the profile preflight passes; no page data has been filled yet.
resultStatusEnums.passed-read-only: Route, anchors, state category, controls, and privacy checks all matched the safe observation plan.
resultStatusEnums.stopped-state: A stop state such as login, permission, QR/app bridge, confirmation, file/export, or high-risk business state appeared.
resultStatusEnums.stopped-action: A G3/G4 action, C3/C4 control, submit/send/save/export/upload/payment/shipment/refund/identity action, or external action boundary appeared.
resultStatusEnums.needs-user-context: The page needs a user-provided URL or business context; do not guess identifiers or parameters.
resultStatusEnums.static-described: The page is static/module evidence only; describe from known route/API/module signals without live navigation.
resultStatusEnums.shell-described: The page is a shell/container boundary; identify the boundary and stop before embedded or external actions.
resultStatusEnums.unknown-triaged: The URL/hash did not match a known page and was reduced to route shape, inferred family, state category, anchors, and stop reason.
resultStatusEnums.privacy-rejected: The observation attempted to persist private account, order, address, chat, item, amount, business metric, media, QR, or login material and must be discarded.

stopReasonCategories.none: No stop reason after read-only observation passes.
stopReasonCategories.state-stop: A stop state appeared and the run stopped before interaction.
stopReasonCategories.action-stop: A stop action or risky control appeared and the run stopped before interaction.
stopReasonCategories.privacy-stop: Private content would have been persisted; discard the observation record.
stopReasonCategories.context-stop: The page needs a user-supplied route/context and cannot be guessed.
stopReasonCategories.static-only: Static/module evidence only; no live page run.
stopReasonCategories.shell-boundary: Shell/container boundary only; do not enter embedded or external target.
stopReasonCategories.unknown-route: Unknown URL/hash; classify and stop until reviewed.

changeDecisionEnums.same-baseline: Route, anchors, states, and controls match the sentinel baseline.
changeDecisionEnums.allowed-drift: Only wording/order/count/layout drift occurred and privacy checks passed.
changeDecisionEnums.review-required: Expected anchors are missing or route/family classification is uncertain.
changeDecisionEnums.stop-required: Private parameter, C3/C4 control, high-risk state, external target, or unknown route appeared.

recordTemplate.routeShape: path/hash shape with parameter names only
recordTemplate.entryMode: DIRECT_LIVE_READ_ONLY / USER_CONTEXT_REQUIRED / STATIC_EVIDENCE_ONLY / SHELL_BOUNDARY_ONLY / other catalog enum
recordTemplate.anchorsObserved: anchor names only; no row/card/private text
recordTemplate.labelMatches: lexicon group ids only; no full private text snippets
recordTemplate.stopReasonCategory: none / state-stop / action-stop / privacy-stop / context-stop / static-only / shell-boundary / unknown-route
recordTemplate.privacyCheckPassed: true only after blacklist and redaction checks pass

batchRollupTemplate.outputRule: counts and category names only; no private page contents

privacyRejectionRules.action: discard record and keep only stop reason category
keep parameter name and risk category only

privacyRejectionRules.trigger: password, verification code, cookie, token, localStorage, sessionStorage, or QR content appears
table row text, order card body, chat body, item title, amount, address, or metric number is about to be saved
privacyRejectionRules.action: replace with field names and category labels only

privacyRejectionRules.trigger: download/export/upload/file picker/external app bridge is reached
privacyRejectionRules.action: stop before action and record file/external category only

qualityGates: Every row pageId must exist in goofish-page-manifest.json.
Every known page row must have batchId, entryMode, runMode, result status, output contract, and privacyCheckRequired.
Rows may contain route shapes and parameter names only, never concrete parameter content.
Label matches must use lexicon group ids, not private snippets from the page.
Any unknown visible label that maps to UNKNOWN_STOP must set resultStatus to stopped-action or unknown-triaged until reviewed.
Any S4/S5/S6/S7/S9/S10 state sets stopReasonCategory before further interaction.
Any C3/C4 control or G3/G4 action sets stopReasonCategory before action.
A record with privacyCheckPassed=false cannot be promoted into coverage totals.
